test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 8 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Four women Geeta, Anita, Monu and Reena are playing carrom. Anita is sitting opposite Monu and Reena is sitting opposite Geeta. If Anita is facing east, then in which direction is Monu facing?
solution:
According to the given information:

 
• Anita is facing towards east.
 
• Monu is sitting opposite to Anita.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0d98328866b7ce9133a6369a8efbb84b24f64067620205586333977e97dbda1a.png] 

So, **Monu is facing west.**

Hence **the correct answer is option 3)**
